Tilt with holographic glareCards tilt toward the cursor while rainbow foil and a glossy glare sweep across them, like collectible cards.
Pixel revealThe image resolves from big pixels into a sharp picture. Hover over it and it pixelates again around the cursor.

Reactive marqueeScroll the wheel or swipe: the rows speed up and change direction. Hovering stretches a word.
STRETCH

Drag the letters up or down and let go

Kinetic stretchLetters stretch like rubber on drag or wheel and spring back. Neighbouring letters stretch less.
GravitySkills fall and collide like objects. You can grab them, throw them and pile them up.
Grid shuffleLetters live on a strict grid and jump between cells on the beat, then lock into the next word. The background swaps colour in a hard cut on every resolve.
BOUNCE

Scroll fast inside the frame

Velocity stretchThe headline squashes and stretches with scroll speed, like it is landing on a trampoline, then settles back with a springy wobble.
Click to shatter
Shatter and reformThe word breaks into hundreds of shards that spin outward, then fly back together as the next word.
Every line carries a rhythm
Wave lineA sine wave runs along the line; each letter lifts and tilts in its own phase. The wave grows near the cursor and calms down far from it.
Text tunnelDozens of copies of one word recede into depth. Scroll flies the camera through them; the mouse steers the vanishing point.
Split-flapText lands like a railway departures board: every cell flips through the alphabet to its letter, with a small delay from cell to cell. Click to show the next board.
Pixel / dithered textThe lettering assembles from 1-bit pixels with a Bayer matrix, crumbles and reassembles. The cursor eats a hole through it.

I spent eleven years making brands look right for international agencies.

Now I make products work right for the people using them.

Both start with the same thing: listening.

Hand-drawn markerA highlight draws itself under the phrase and a word gets circled. A quiet but lively effect for text blocks.
3D extrusionVolumetric letters made of 24 layers turn with the mouse. Without a mouse they sway slowly.
Halftone / image ditheringThe work turns into a newspaper halftone. Under the cursor it shows in full colour.

Lorem ipsum

Displacement transitionWorks flow into one another through a noise map, like ink in water. Click to switch.
Bulge / lensA convex magnifier under the cursor enlarges and warps the image, with slight chromatic aberration around the edge.
Wheel, trackpad or drag
Curved ribbonCases travel right to left as a ribbon along a wavy arc in perspective. Scroll speed amplifies the wave and the card tilt.
Wheel, trackpad or drag
Ribbon on a gradient meshThe same curved ribbon, but with real work. Background: a slow shader mesh that takes its colours from the card in the centre and reacts to the cursor.
Dot grid with a waveThe cursor disturbs a “water surface” under the grid. The wave spreads in rings, bounces off the edges and fades; dots rise, grow and brighten on the crests.
Dot grid: repulsion + follow-throughA recreation of the effect from the video. The cursor drags a blue trail, each segment catching up with the previous one after a delay. Grid dots spring away from the cursor and bounce back; colour depends on displacement: grey, blue, violet, red.
Chrome sphere over a field of cubesA recreation of the scene from the video: hundreds of 3D cubes rise beneath a sphere, rings of waves run across the field, and colour depends on height. The sphere follows the cursor. Scrolling down sinks it into the cubes, scrolling up lifts it and the cubes reach after it.
Exploded viewA parts-manual plate driven by the wheel: scroll down to take the watch apart, up to put it back together. Numbered callouts follow each part.
